$comment: Confirmed 2026-09-28 from a draft of TransLink alert 757208.

disruptions.text: Expo Line Track Maintenance on Mon Sep 28 from 9:30 PM until the end of service.
disruptions.note:
Expo Line Track Maintenance on Mon Sep 28 from 9:30 PM until the end of service. Trains will single-track in both directions between Edmonds Station & Royal Oak Station. Platform 1 will be closed; please board all trains from Platform 2 at both stations.


Expo Line trains will operate Waterfront <-> King George/Production Way, stopping at Royal Oak platform 2 and Edmonds platform 2 in both directions.

Additional short-turn trains will operate Waterfront <-> Metrotown and Edmonds <-> King George / Production Way. 

Some trains will dwell longer than normal at Metrotown and 22nd Street Stations.

Trips through Royal Oak Station will be delayed, with the worst affected trips taking approximately 15 minutes longer than normal.
